At p=(d-1)/d both lower bounds equal r^{d-1}|B|^p, since β+s^{d-1}=r^{d-1}. All bodies reconstructed are positive, and the two summands and all cap bodies are homothetic.

In standard simplex coordinates q and q-se_i fit in tB exactly when q_i≥s and ∑q_i≤t, hence t≥ds. The tested scale ratio is d^{1/(d-1)}, strictly below d for d≥3. In d=3 the displayed scales are 9/8 and 3√3/8.
